authorization.scope: Two approved v02 Depth images, asset prompts and standard 12-step parameters; three candidates per building, no refinement or runtime installation

assets.label: 燃油发电厂 v02
assets.primaryRequest: industrial-era oil-fired power plant with a two-storey engine hall and one tall open smokestack
assets.structureRequest: industrial-era oil-fired power plant: exactly two aligned engine-hall storeys under one continuous pitched roof; one tall tapered chimney on the screen-left with a visibly hollow open top, ladder and connecting flue; two horizontal fuel tanks along the lower left yard. Preserve both rows of factory windows, the open double entrance and the small oil-drop plus lightning emblem
assets.detailRequest: retain the selected plant geometry and open chimney mouth; refine only its established broad masonry, slate, painted fuel-tank metal and sparse hardware wear
assets.paletteConstraint: cool gray masonry and warm-gray stone bands, dark blue-gray slate roof, muted ochre fuel tanks, blackened iron flue and ladder, dark blue-green glazing; small dark tarnished brass emblem
assets.negativeRequest: no capped chimney, sealed exhaust mouth, extra chimney or tank, smoke cloud, cooling tower, solar panel, dense brick joints or miniature roof-tile noise
assets.modelApproval: User accepted this exact v02 model and requested 12-step generation; geometry and Depth are frozen
assets.selectionUserReply: 按你建议继续，但是考虑到抠图，尽量不要把楼梯跟绿幕重叠，记住这个

assets.label: 罐头加工厂 v02
assets.primaryRequest: distinctive industrial-era cannery with a barrel-vault processing hall and tin-shaped ingredient tower
assets.structureRequest: industrial-era cannery with one curved barrel-roof processing hall, broad factory glazing and an open front packing doorway. The attached screen-left ingredient tank resembles a large sealed tin with rolled rims and an embossed tomato-and-leaf badge; it is equipment, not a second building. Preserve the horizontal locking-door sterilizing retort, exposed front can conveyor and sealing press, one large tin-shaped facade sign, and the modeled produce and finished-can crates
assets.detailRequest: retain the selected canning hall, sealed ingredient tower, retort, conveyor and tin signs; refine only the established plaster, curved metal roof, tinplate and restrained label colors
assets.paletteConstraint: warm cream-gray plaster with subdued terracotta piers, dark desaturated green-gray metal vault roof, matte gray tinplate tanks and cans, dark iron rollers, muted brick-red can labels and awning, tiny dull olive produce leaves; windows are dark neutral blue-green
assets.negativeRequest: no chimney or smoke, extra storey, sawtooth roof, brewery barrels, silo cluster, giant loose food, brand lettering or advertising text; no glossy chrome, candy-red labels or dense surface grain
assets.modelApproval: User accepted this exact v02 model and requested 12-step generation; geometry and Depth are frozen
assets.selectionUserReply: 按你建议继续，但是考虑到抠图，尽量不要把楼梯跟绿幕重叠，记住这个
